summary: E2E frontend validation of 18+ Age Gate (Wine + Pharmacy), Delivery Genie shopping list and Parcel insurance + signature toggle. All 6 specialty flows pass. Logged in as a fresh user-role account, exercised every required data-testid, verified localStorage persistence, French validation toast, +2.00 EUR insurance fee, signature toggle and successful parcel creation (redirect to /track/parcel/{id}).

age_gate_wine.details: Overlay [age-gate] appears on first visit to /food?type=wine, contains title 'Vérification d'âge', confirm + decline buttons. Confirming dismisses overlay, reveals [store-list-page] and sets localStorage.sb_age_ok_wine='1'. Reload of /food?type=wine no longer shows the gate (persistence verified).

age_gate_pharmacy.details: After confirming Wine gate, visiting /pharmacy still shows the age-gate overlay (sb_age_ok_pharmacy was null) -> confirms independence of localStorage keys. Confirming reveals [pharmacy-page] and sets localStorage.sb_age_ok_pharmacy='1'.

age_gate_independence.details: Wine and Pharmacy use separate keys (sb_age_ok_wine vs sb_age_ok_pharmacy). Confirming Wine did NOT auto-confirm Pharmacy.

delivery_genie_validation.details: Submitting with empty [genie-items] (pickup filled) shows French toast 'Indiquez ce que le Genie doit acheter' as expected.

delivery_genie_submit_success.details: Filling pickup via 'Ma position', genie-items='Lait, Pain, Oeufs', genie-store='Carrefour', genie-budget=25, drop via Google Places autocomplete ('10 Rue de Rivoli, 75004 Paris'), drop-phone='+33612345678' and clicking [submit-runner-btn] navigates to /track/parcel/{id} (order created).

parcel_insurance_fee.details: Single-moto flow: pickup via 'Ma position', drop via [parcel-stop-map-btn-0] map picker (Confirmer ce lieu), Estimer le prix -> confirm screen renders [parcel-options-section], [parcel-insurance-toggle], [parcel-signature-toggle]. Initial [confirm-total-fare]='2,00 €'; after toggling insurance ON, value becomes '4,00 €' -> diff exactly +2.00 EUR (matches backend insurance fee).

parcel_signature_toggle.details: Signature toggle is interactive on the confirm screen.

parcel_create_success.details: Clicking [parcel-confirm-btn] creates the parcel and the app navigates to /track/parcel/{parcel_id} (the success screen [parcel-success] is shown briefly for ~2.2s before auto-redirect — verified by capturing the resulting tracking URL with a valid parcel_xxxxxxxx id and tracker page rendering).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: ParcelPage.confirm() auto-redirects from [parcel-success] to /track/parcel/{id} after 2.2s — test scripts that look for [parcel-success] must check within ~2s or assert the navigation to /track/parcel/. Current testid is fine but timing is tight; consider keeping the success screen until the user dismisses it.
Minor: AgeGate decline button uses navigate(-1) which can leave the user on a blank/garbage page if there is no history. Consider navigate('/home') as a safer fallback.
test_credentials: Fresh user registered each run via POST /api/auth/register (email=qa_user_<ts>@example.com / Passw0rd!23 / role=user). UI login via [email-login-btn] then email+password form.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test user(s) and two test parcels (parcel_fae8e56c856e, parcel_1d9789a8761a) via the normal user flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow on mobile starts on phone step — must click [data-testid='email-login-btn'] before filling email/password. Geolocation is reliably granted via page.context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation(Paris 48.8566,2.3522), so 'Ma position' buttons work in headless. For Drop in Genie/RunnerPage, type into [data-testid='runner-drop'] (e.g. '10 rue de Rivoli Paris'), wait ~2s, then ArrowDown+Enter to pick first Google Places suggestion. For Parcel drop, use [parcel-stop-map-btn-0] -> wait for reverse-geocoded address -> [map-picker-confirm]. After parcel confirm, the app redirects to /track/parcel/{id}; the [parcel-success] testid is visible <2.2s.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 6 features behave exactly as specified in the request.
